name: Mayday: Sea Rescue
description:
Answer mayday calls and save people at sea! Race out on a jet ski or a rescue RIB, pull survivors from the waves, and bring them home to Port Haven.

Every 15 minutes a storm sweeps the Gale Isles. Waves rise, rain lashes the harbour and the big calls come in, like a capsized ferry with passengers trapped on the hull. Team up with your crew to save them all.

- Rescue a person in the water, tow a disabled boat home, or work the capsized ferry
- Grab them, throw a line, or let them swim to you: more than one way works
- Crew up with friends, or go solo with an NPC crew
- Earn certifications and rank up from Recruit to Rescue Swimmer
- Bosun, the station dog, comes along on every call
- Dive the wrecks and explore the coast to fill your logbook
